page_title: GIR 2-3 BET | Girona v Betis 21/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Beek D. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' The linesman raises his flag. Axel Witsel (Girona) is adjudged offside.
90+3' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Hugo Rincon (Girona) jumps into a tackle and Iosu Galech signals a foul.
88' Substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli walks off the pitch and Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
86' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Girona players look gutted.
86' Attention! Referee Iosu Galech straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
86' The attendance for today's match is 11934.
85' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
84' Thomas Lemar (Girona) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

84' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him. The ball goes out of play and Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
83' Here is a change. Arnau Martinez is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Hugo Rincon (Girona).
83' Substitution. Ivan Martin leaves the pitch and is replaced by Thomas Lemar (Girona).
82' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

80' 2 - 3 Abde Ezzalzouli is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom right corner to make the score 2:3.
79' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) is booked by the referee.
79' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) is the one who receives a yellow card.
78' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
76' Vitor Reis (Girona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
75' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hector Bellerin (Betis) replacing Aitor Ruibal.
75' We are about to witness a subsitution. Isco (Betis) for Pablo Fornals.
74' Sofyan Amrabat (Betis) is penalised for holding. Iosu Galech signals a set piece.
74' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
73' Substitution. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) has come on for Claudio Echeverri.
72' Marc Roca (Betis) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Iosu Galech blows for a foul.
68' 2 - 2 Goal! Alvaro Valles gets a hand on the penalty from Azzedine Ounahi (Girona), but can't stop it from flying into the top left corner.
68' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

67' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Iosu Galech blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. The referee makes the call - penalty to Girona!
66' That will be all from Fran Beltran who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Joel Roca (Girona).
63' 1 - 2 Goal! Cedric Bakambu plays a pass to the feet of Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) and he shoots low into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 1:2.

61' A short pass finds Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
61' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
59' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Iosu Galech who sees an offensive foul.
56' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
55' Daley Blind (Girona) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
53' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) sends a chip pass into the box, but Alvaro Valles is quickest to intercept the ball.
50' Iosu Galech shows a yellow card to Cedric Bakambu (Betis) for his blatant foul.
48' Rough tackle by Vitor Reis (Girona). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Manuel Pellegrini decided to make a change. Cucho Hernandez (Betis) is replaced by Cedric Bakambu.
46' Half-time substitution. Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) will not participate anymore and Rodrigo Riquelme is coming on.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

45+1' Daley Blind (Girona) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes behind for a corner. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) makes a strong challenge and Iosu Galech blows for a foul.
43' Daley Blind (Girona) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
42' Sofyan Amrabat (Betis) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Iosu Galech no option but to blow his whistle.
41' Handball by Viktor Tsygankov (Girona).
39' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
38' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
34' Iosu Galech interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Vitor Reis (Girona).

30' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from the edge of the box. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.

29' Vitor Reis (Girona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Iosu Galech has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Betis are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
27' Total attempts – 4:1.

23' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Marc Roca (Betis) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Paulo Gazzaniga, so the score changes to 1:1.
20' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Girona was in an offside position.
19' Marc Roca (Betis) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Iosu Galech blows his whistle for a foul.
16' The referee points to the corner flag and Girona will take a corner.
15' Claudio Echeverri (Girona) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Now Girona have a corner.
11' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) gets on the end of a pass, but mishits his shot and sends it well wide of the right post.
9' It's like he was asking for a caution. Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) receives a yellow card.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
3' A pass by Cucho Hernandez (Betis) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' The match has just started.
Girona will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Iosu Galech.
